title: Connect An Email Account to Microsoft Outlook
text:
## Connect An Email Account to Microsoft Outlook
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000013793
Click on File >> Add Account:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12008002886/original/blob1470076468785.png?1470076469 | alt: ]
Select Manual setup or additional server types and click on "Next":
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12008002921/original/blob1470076516545.png?1470076517 | alt: ]
Select "POP or IMAP" and click on "Next":
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12008003129/original/blob1470076920040.png?1470076920 | alt: ]
The information for this step can be obtained from cPanel as shown in this article . Enter the the following information: Your Name: (the name you want to display the email is from when sending emails) Email Address: (the email address you created in cPanel) Account Type: POP3 Incoming mail server: (the "Incoming Server" recommended for this email account in cPanel) Outgoing mail server: (the "Outgoing Server" recommended for this email account in cPanel) User Name: (the full email address) Password: (the password you used when creating the email account)
Click on "More Settings":
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12008003695/original/blob1470078147530.png?1470078148 | alt: ]
Click on the "Outgoing Server" tab and check the "My outgoing server (SMTP) requires authentication" checkbox, select "Use same settings as my incoming mail server" and click on "OK":
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12008003206/original/blob1470077086072.png?1470077086 | alt: ]
Click on "Next":
Click on "Next":
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12008003709/original/blob1470078166883.png?1470078167 | alt: ]
Outlook will run a test to make sure email can be received and sent using those credentials.  If it is successful, it should look like it does below.  Click on "Close":
Outlook will run a test to make sure email can be received and sent using those credentials.  If it is successful, it should look like it does below.  Click on "Close":
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12008003264/original/blob1470077186912.png?1470077187 | alt: ]
You should then see a success message.  Click on "Finish" to complete the setup.
You should then see a success message.  Click on "Finish" to complete the setup.
